verdict.rationale: dltHub documents run monitoring: its CLI and Web UI let you monitor pipeline health, inspect logs and diagnose failures, and it states that every run is logged and auditable. That covers run status and logs. Nothing in the evidence shows per-sync row counts or failure alerting to Slack, email or a webhook. Missing for 10: per-sync row count reporting, failure alerts via Slack/email/webhook, independent or hands-on corroboration of the monitoring UI.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I see run status, logs, and row counts per sync, and failures alert me in Slack, email, or a webhook

citations.quote: Use the dltHub CLI and the Web UI at app.dlthub.com to monitor pipeline health, inspect logs, and diagnose failures.
Schedule, refresh, backfill, and observe runs with a familiar decorator-based Python API.
Every run is logged and auditable.
